paper_title: Read-Write Quorum Load under Known Crashes
method: Statement-by-statement comparison of the paper with the Lean model and declarations. The SHA-256 hash identifies the paper version.

model.families: The families are fixed. Every read quorum intersects every write quorum. Quorums in the same phase may be disjoint.
model.availability: Both phases have normalized routes for every allowed failed set, even when one phase has zero traffic.
model.routing: Clients know the failed set F before choosing contacts. The routes may depend on F and the real-valued read fraction alpha.
model.cost: Each server contact costs one unit. Alpha is the fraction of quorum phases that are reads.
model.balanced: Paper t corresponds to Lean r; n=t*t-1 corresponds to n+1=r*r. alpha=1/2, <=2 known failures, fixed reads are all t-server cyclic intervals. H=(2t-1)/(2(t-2)(t+1)); matching lower bound only for these reads, arbitrary compatible write families.
model.full_range: Lean-checked as printed, limits included. m=n-f, beta=alpha*(1-alpha). L*(alpha)=L*(1-alpha); L* >= max{(f+1)/m, 2*sqrt(beta/m)}; for m>=16*f*f, L* <= 20*max{(f+1)/m, sqrt(beta/m)}; L*=(1+o(1))*2*sqrt(beta/n) when min{alpha,1-alpha}*n/(f*f) grows.
model.unknown_failures: Lean-checked as printed, limits included. Contact sets fixed before failures and containing a live quorum after any f later crashes; equivalently contact families with pairwise read/write intersections of size 2f+1. Lower bound max{(2f+1)/n, 2*sqrt((2f+1)*beta/n)}; exact value 2dq/(q*q+dn) at alpha=q*q/(q*q+dn), d=2f+1, q|n, q>=d. Comparison with the known-failure optimum only; no protocol is analysed.
model.not_claimed: Exact values for all (n,f,alpha), the range where alpha*n is comparable to f*f, heterogeneous costs, or performance gains
